semantic_reason: Full shelf transfer is physical slots serialized to a carried block item then restored at placement, already represented by portable shulker custody family. Different component/key names, row count, display enum and client SET packet do not justify another semantic mechanism. No distinct old-format conversion, schema conflict handling or overflow escrow was found in reviewed chain.
actual_observations: Tile inv reader/writer delegates ItemStackHandler and independently stores unchecked RenderTextType ordinal. Block item uses ItemInventoryCap CUSTOM_DATA.inventory, not tile inv key.

playerDestroy copies min(source,target) slots into new item capability; setPlacedBy copies min slots back. No overflow recovery, no transfer of renderStyle or whole tile metadata. Copies actual ItemStacks, no minting via quest reward.
ItemInventoryCap constructor and onContentsChanged use RegistryHolder; absent registry returns without hydrate/save. Updates copy existing CUSTOM_DATA before replacing inventory key.
AutoSync handler insert/extract sends SET, emptySlot bypasses notify; client consumer clears slot before insertion. This is display sync, not another durable ownership migration.
Shelf local onContentsChanged does not override native no-op here; comparator helper only notifies neighbours. No claim persistence dirty scheduling is proven.
